race.comment: PAPASITO (4) is worth following up after winning well at Rocky after leading them up. His record around 1100m is excellent and Olzard knows him well. Can win again. UPSTART LEGEND (3) was only beaten a long neck at this track last start as favourite and again rates as a live hope. Doesn't have to improve much to land the winning blow this time. RED HOT LIZZIE (1) has to rebound from a disappointing effort behind PAPASITO, when almost too bad to be true. She's unbeaten from three starts at this track and has a strong 1100m record. Worth another chance. JIMMYINTHEJUNGLE (7) is a lightweight flyer knocking on the door. Blinkers first time from the good draw give him a chance.
